slides.title: Define f, then literally type f(5)
slides.question: If $f(x) = 2x - 7$, what is the value of $f(5)$?
slides.caption: Desmos prints $= 3$ right next to it. No substituting, no sign slips.

slides.title: Put both versions on screen at once
slides.question: The graph of $y = x^2$ is shifted $3$ units right and $2$ units up. Which equation gives the new graph?
slides.caption: Type your candidate next to the original: $y = (x - 3)^2 + 2$. The vertex lands at $(3, 2)$, exactly where the shift says.

slides.title: The same rule works on absolute value
slides.question: The graph of $y = |x|$ is shifted $2$ units right and $3$ units down. Which equation gives the new graph?
slides.caption: $y = |x - 2| - 3$. Inside the bars slides it sideways, outside slides it vertically. Same logic, different shape.
